regime_context: The TSX theme detector shows Big Banks as the dominant narrative with strong momentum, full breadth, and trend-gate eligibility. The absolute trend gate is validated here (gate_helps: true), serving as a drawdown risk control. Crowding is elevated in the leader, warranting sizing caution—not a fade. The rotation is broad but not one-narrative, and the leadership margin over Base Metals remains wide with no confirmed handoff. Rank-IC is ~0, so all directional leans are falsifiable conditionals, not return forecasts.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The absolute trend gate confirms an uptrend (eligible=true, durability_bar=0.7), and breadth is at maximum (1.0). The theme is the undisputed leader with no imminent handoff. Crowding (z=1.23) calls for downside risk sizing, not a reversal call. The overweight is a trend-discipline posture, contingent on the gate staying favorable.
theses.dissent: Elevated crowding can cap upside and increase crash risk; momentum rank has zero return-forecast edge.

falsifier.text: If Big Banks flips to ineligible (absolute trend gate breaks) or breadth drops below 0.5.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is ineligible in the trend gate (eligible=false, durability_bar=0.31), indicating no confirmed absolute uptrend. The validated drawdown-control edge of the gate argues for avoiding such names until an uptrend re-establishes. Momentum rank is low (rank 8) and breadth thin (0.25).
theses.dissent: Gold miners can rally sharply on risk-off flows, circumventing the trend gate's risk-control objective.

falsifier.text: If Gold Miners becomes eligible and its durability_bar rises above 0.4.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Also ineligible (eligible=false, durability_bar=0.23). Low momentum rank and negligible breadth (0.167) confirm weak structure. Gate discipline suggests avoidance until an absolute trend is re-established.
theses.dissent: Silver/royalty equities are volatile and could benefit from episodic safe-haven flows, delivering returns that an avoid stance would miss.

falsifier.text: If Silver & Royalties becomes eligible with durability_bar >0.3 and breadth improving.
